findings.title: No test pins that the chosen view limit is sent on create (req-panel-choice)
findings.failure_scenario: Suppose someone later deletes `viewLimit: getViewLimit(viewLimit)` at MemoSharePanel.tsx:128, deletes `viewLimit,` at useMemoShareQueries.ts:41, or breaks getViewLimit at MemoSharePanel.tsx:16-18. All 3 tests in memo-share-panel.test.tsx still pass, because they only call formatViewCount. A user could then pick 1 view and get an unlimited link, and no test would catch it. The current code sends the limit correctly, so the outcome today is a regression nothing would catch, not wrong behaviour.
findings.evidence: web/tests/memo-share-panel.test.tsx:3 imports only formatViewCount. Lines 12-26 hold the only describe block, `describe("formatViewCount"`, with 3 cases. No test renders MemoSharePanel, calls useCreateMemoShare or mocks memoServiceClient.createMemoShare. The untested code is the getViewLimit mapping at MemoSharePanel.tsx:16-18, the handleCreate call at :128, and the hook at useMemoShareQueries.ts:38-43, which puts viewLimit into the MemoShare sent to createMemoShare. The ledger entry shows the task covers req-panel-choice.
findings.fix: Add a test that mocks memoServiceClient.createMemoShare, renders the panel (or calls the hook), picks "10 views" and creates. Assert the request memoShare.viewLimit is 10, and that it is unset for "no limit".
findings.verification_note: I read the test file, MemoSharePanel.tsx and useMemoShareQueries.ts in the worktree. The test file has only formatViewCount tests (lines 12-26), and nothing covers getViewLimit, handleCreate or the hook's viewLimit field. So each mutation the finding names would leave the suite green, which confirms the coverage gap. The current code is correct, though. getViewLimit maps "none" to undefined and the other options through Number(), handleCreate passes the result, and the hook sets it on the MemoShare it sends. No user hits a wrong outcome today, so I lowered the finding to no-harm-yet (minor). It is not defect-narrow-trigger. Context: the plan's Acceptance for this task only asks for the view-count text test, but the task's covers list includes req-panel-choice, so a test for that choice is still missing.

notes:
Exported `formatViewCount(share: MemoShare, t): string` from MemoSharePanel.tsx; "3 of 10 views" when viewLimit set, else "3 views". `useCreateMemoShare` mutate takes `{ memoName, expireTime?, viewLimit? }`. en.json keys under memo.share: view-count, view-count-limited, views-unlimited, views-1, views-10, views-100. The first gate run was RED with "could not start /bin/sh" (sandbox fault); rerun with sandbox disabled was GREEN. The slice gate only builds web, so the tests ran locally via vitest (3 pass), and pnpm lint passed.
